note: A single shaded site on a short dirt pull-through lane that parallels PA 144 and has two entrances, about 5.4 miles south of Ole Bull State Park and 2.4 miles north of Cross Fork Creek Road. The agency notes that the access road is paved but the campsite parking is dirt, and to be cautious with some vehicles. Stone fire ring; no table, toilet or water. Pack out trash. --Claude
summary: Site page re-read: 015 Head Gate still listed, Drive-In, RV/Tent/Trailer categories, max vehicle and equipment length 100 ft; count 1 and 100 ft confirmed, pull_through true written from the page's description (the attribute line says Back-In; see flags). Year-round confirmed; sells in all five windows. Fees confirmed, $6.50 reservation fee added; hookups and facilities none. Imagery (Esri leaf-on and PASDA leaf-off): pin about 20-25 m south-west of PA 144 under closed canopy; the lane and pad are not resolved, pin not moved. NHD: Kettle Creek 124 m away through forest; not waterfront.
flags: pull_through: the page contradicts itself: the attribute reads 'Driveway Entry: Back-In' while the description reads 'There is a short pull through road paralleling 144 with 2 entrances.' pull_through true was written from the description, with both in the sites note. Imagery cannot settle it (closed canopy).

100 ft confirmed as the page's figure: 'Max Vehicle Length: 100', 'Equipment Length: 100', 'Site Length: 100', 'Site Width: 30', spur 90. The DCNR GIS record adds NumberVehicles 5 and the note '(NumberSites: 5)'; the booking system sells it as one site.

Agency access statements (ruling 11: nothing measured, no road surface, gate or bridge research): 'Caution: This campsite is accessed from a paved road, but campsite parking is dirt. Be cautious with some vehicles.' 'Site Grade: Slight', 'Driveway Grade: Slight', 'Driveway Surface: Dirt', 'Site Height/Overhead Clearance: 20'. No Severe grade, no 4WD or wet-weather statement, no closure. Kept. The page also carries the district-wide 'Road and Travel Alert' and '4WD vehicles may be recommended for some sites year-round, check notes' boilerplate (this site's notes say nothing about 4WD).
Waterfront: NHD puts Kettle Creek 124 m from the pin (a second unnamed channel 111 m), with forest between on both image sets. The page makes no water claim. Stays not waterfront.

ATV check (ruling 1): the site page(s) say nothing about ATVs and do not call the ground a parking area. The DCNR Susquehannock ATV Trail brochure names five trailheads (District Office, Sunken Branch, Route 44, Rock Run, Lyman); none is this site. The camp at the Rock Run trailhead is a separate site, '029 Rock Run ATV' in the DCNR GIS layer, not part of this entry. Kept.
NAME: the stored name carries the site's own name and road as the booking system gives them ('Site, Loop: 015 Head Gate, Rte 144'); nothing to change.
Equestrian check: the Susquehannock camping page names the Dyer and Horsey Hilton equestrian areas; this entry is neither and its page(s) list no horse category.

Susquehannock advisories page (read 2026-11-10): district office closure Oct 17-18, 2026; Rausch Road reopened July 31, 2025; 'Stay Alert for ATVs on Roads' (the Northcentral Regional ATV Trail uses some PennDOT, township and forest roads); a dust advisory. No road closure, gate, bridge limit or timber-sale notice, and nothing on this entry's road. The camping page publishes no seasonal closure or site rotation.
